text:
lina (Finance Ops): Heads up — VectorLabs says they received two March invoice PDFs. One file is missing the 'Reserved GPU support' line (~$2,750). The other is a duplicate but shows JPY 2,750 instead of USD. Both were emailed. Can billing triage?

ben (Billing Eng): on it. I see invoice_job-12754 ran, then retried a few seconds later. Retry had env.SKIP_CONSISTENCY=true so dedupe/validation skipped. Likely read a partial usage blob during retry.

invoice-bot: alert invoice_service job-12754 retried (reason: storage PUT timeout). tasks: job-12754 / job-12754-retry.

ben (Billing Eng): log snippet:
2026-04-21T03:12:01Z INFO invoice_job-12754 start
2026-04-21T03:12:02Z ERROR storage PUT /tmp/inv_INV-2026-0368.pdf timeout
2026-04-21T03:12:04Z INFO job-12754-retry completed (wrote INV-2026-0368.pdf)

claire (Revenue Ops): Customer message: "INV-2026-0368.pdf (no reserved support line) and INV-2026-0368-dup.pdf (JPY amounts). Which should we use?" They want corrected invoice + credit note for duplicate.

tom (Accounting): Approve re-issue + credit note. Need corrected PDF before COB and include original file names and a short explanation in the credit note footer. VAT must be applied (customer provided VAT id).

amanda (Support): I'll tell the customer ETA and pause auto-capture for their account until we send corrected docs. :pray:

ben (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) patch generator to never skip consistency/dedupe on retries; 2) wait for aggregator commit marker before reading usage; 3) add pre-send validation to block sends when expected lines (usage>0) missing; 4) re-run job-12754 with dedupe enforced and produce CN-2026-0079 referencing the duplicate file.

lina (Finance Ops): Approved. Please only re-email once pre-send check passes. If blocked, create a BLOCKED invoice ticket and notify CS.

ben (Billing Eng): Will do. Creating BILL-1534. ETA reissue ~2.5h after patch lands to staging. I'll post updates to the ticket and cc eng-sre for storage/consistency review.

amanda (Support): Noted — I'll update VectorLabs and hold payment until we confirm.

claire (Revenue Ops): Add canned message for CS: "We mistakenly sent duplicate invoice PDFs due to an internal retry; please use the corrected invoice and attached credit note for your records."

lina (Finance Ops): Thanks — include root cause and remediation steps in BILL-1534 for the monthly billing postmortem.

ben (Billing Eng): Will include RCA and tag eng-sre.
